verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says it identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files, which documents diarization. Nothing in the evidence shows those speakers are matched to real participant names rather than generic labels. The attendee-email filter in the transcripts query is a different feature and gets no credit. missing for 10: documented real-name speaker matching (e.g., mapping to calendar attendees or meeting-platform names), speaker-attribution accuracy evidence, API speaker-name fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"

citations.quote: Fireflies identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files.
